firstPlayerRule: Draw the top card of the shuffled turn-order deck to determine who takes the first turn. It can be a player or the nemesis.
clarifications: Draw another turn-order card after each player or nemesis turn. If the deck is empty, shuffle the discarded turn-order cards to form a new deck.
In a three-player game, if the wild turn-order card appears, the players decide who takes that turn.
